Name: SHIELD_PARAM_ST
Description: Defines certain shield or PA-related values for players and NPCs.

Fields.Name: Guard Base Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly used as the direction reference for the shield. -1: the master.

Fields.Name: Guard Detect Position Master Override
Fields.Description: If ON, the guard check uses the character's master position instead of the dummy poly position.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Guard Angle
Fields.Description: Horizontal direction in which the shield is deployed. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Vertical Guard Angle
Fields.Description: Vertical direction in which the shield is deployed. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Guard Range
Fields.Description: Horizontal coverage of the shield. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Vertical Guard Range
Fields.Description: Vertical coverage of the shield. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Pulse Armor 1 Guard Base Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly used as the direction reference for Pulse Armor 1. -1: the master.

Fields.Name: Pulse Armor 1 Detect Position Master Override
Fields.Description: If ON, the Pulse Armor 1 guard check uses the character's master position instead of the dummy poly position.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Pulse Armor 1 Angle
Fields.Description: Horizontal direction in which Pulse Armor 1 is deployed. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Vertical Pulse Armor 1 Angle
Fields.Description: Vertical direction in which Pulse Armor 1 is deployed. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Pulse Armor 1 Range
Fields.Description: Horizontal coverage of Pulse Armor 1. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Vertical Pulse Armor 1 Range
Fields.Description: Vertical coverage of Pulse Armor 1. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Pulse Armor 2 Guard Base Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly used as the direction reference for Pulse Armor 2. -1: the master.

Fields.Name: Pulse Armor 2 Detect Position Master Override
Fields.Description: If ON, the Pulse Armor 2 guard check uses the character's master position instead of the dummy poly position.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Pulse Armor 2 Angle
Fields.Description: Horizontal direction in which Pulse Armor 2 is deployed. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Vertical Pulse Armor 2 Angle
Fields.Description: Vertical direction in which Pulse Armor 2 is deployed. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Pulse Armor 2 Range
Fields.Description: Horizontal coverage of Pulse Armor 2. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Vertical Pulse Armor 2 Range
Fields.Description: Vertical coverage of Pulse Armor 2. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Pulse Armor Recovery Guard Value
Fields.Description: Sets when the Pulse Armor can be deployed again after a guard break.
